statement:
∀ (k : ℕ), 1 ≤ k →
  let q : ℕ := 2^k
  let m : ℕ := 2^(k+1)
  ∀ f : ZMod m → ℝ,
    (∑ r ∈ (Finset.range q).filter (fun r => Odd r), (f (r : ZMod m) - f ((r+q : ℕ) : ZMod m))^2) =
      2 / (m.totient : ℝ) * ∑ χ ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ m)).filter (fun χ => χ.conductor = m),
        ‖∑ x : (ZMod m)ˣ, (f (x : ZMod m) : ℂ) * star (χ (x : ZMod m))‖^2

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 二进反射与 Levent GRH · DR-0004 · 把两子类之差的平方和转换为本原特征能量
plain_statement.en: New route · Dyadic reflection and Levent GRH · DR-0004 · Convert the squared differences of the two child classes to primitive character energy

brief.zh: 将任意实的模 2q 权 f 投影为 (f(x)−f(x+q))/2。每对奇代表只计一次，故能量系数为 2/φ(2q)。用于 DR-0012 和 DR-0017。
brief.en: Project the real weight f at modulus 2q to (f(x)−f(x+q))/2. Count each odd pair once to obtain the factor 2/φ(2q). DR-0012 and DR-0017 use this normalization.
